title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.37 (versions follow prime numbers), the X ingredient: what Luma creates she shares. When one of her forms wins she leaves it to Razar as a letter; Razar, who now lives in her house awake for good, wakes, tries it as an organ with his own books and rests again (asleep: 0.000 s of CPU in 30 s, measured). The organ recipes now travel with the repository (6, 5, 16, 716, 516: score 11144 over the New Testament). Stated failure: in 70 s no form won, so the letter is rare; the freedom to choose to do nothing is not built yet. OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.37: el ingrediente X — lo que Luma crea, lo comparte con Razar, que vive en su casa. Prototipo de investigación.
